notes: kb/Work PB5424 landed. §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR5: in CF, PH, PF and RF groups "SOURCE clauses and associated USE statements must not reference" a group containing a control data item, an item subordinate to one, or a redefinition or renaming of any part of one, and "In page heading and page footing report groups, SOURCE clauses and USE statements must not reference control data-names." One relation, ReportSectionBinder.ControlDataReferenceOf (over SourceControlRelation and StorageExtent), answers both halves below 2002 with COBOL6825: the SOURCE half in ScreenSourceControlData, the USE half in ReportWriterBinder.CheckControlDataReferences, which StatementBinder.BindStatement asks of every statement bound in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure over the references the statement writes itself (BoundReferences.Of). Witnesses: the PH procedure DISPLAYing the control item and the CF procedure DISPLAYing the group holding it are refused at 85 and accepted from 2002; a CF procedure DISPLAYing the control item itself runs at every edition (the rule bars the data-name only in PH and PF).

next.reason: 1985: "SOURCE clauses and associated USE statements must not reference any of the following: a. Group data items containing a control data item."; 2023: "The 2023 TYPE clause syntax rules (SR-13.18.57.3-9 to -16) cover the report group types but state no limit on SOURCE/USE references to control data". The 2023 TYPE clause rules cover report group types, yet none bars SOURCE or USE in CF, PH, PF or RF groups from referencing control data items, their groups, subordinates or redefinitions.
